players.product: Optical fiber preform (PCVD and VAD/OVD), single-mode and multimode fiber and cable for telecom and AI data centers (G.654.E, polarization-maintaining, multi-core, hollow-core fiber, high-fiber-count ribbon cable); optical interconnect components (optical modules, AOCs, MPO / MMC connectors, FAUs)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: 2025 operating revenue RMB 14,252,103,033, up 16.85%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 813,737,266, up 20.40%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 516,163,517, up 40.56%; gross margin 30.7% versus 27.3% in 2024 (company: the first time above 30% since its 2014 Hong Kong listing), on higher production efficiency and a better product mix. Fourth-quarter revenue RMB 3,976,800,353 (first quarter RMB 2,893,750,963); fourth-quarter net profit about RMB 3.44 hundred million, up about 234.2%, with a 35.7% gross margin (company: its highest single-quarter margin since listing). Operating cash flow RMB 3,652,897,527, up 104.83%; contract liabilities RMB 631,591,920, up 133.75%.

2025 annual report: optical transmission products segment (preform, fiber, cable and related) revenue RMB 8,346,356,236, up 6.09%, gross margin 35.90% (up 4.22 points); optical interconnect components segment revenue RMB 3,143,858,396, up 48.58%, gross margin 39.73% (up 10.45 points); other products RMB 2,496,443,983, gross margin 4.05%. Overseas revenue about RMB 60.92 hundred million, up about 47.81% (42.74% of revenue); mainland China revenue about RMB 81.60 hundred million, up about 1.04%. Diversified businesses brought in about RMB 59.0 hundred million, above 40% of revenue for the first time.

Company (2025 annual report): from 2023 through the first three quarters of 2025 global fiber and cable demand and ordinary single-mode fiber prices were under pressure, and 2025 global cable demand had not recovered to the level of three years earlier; from the fourth quarter of 2025 the market improved - telecom infrastructure building recovered in Southeast Asia, Europe and the Americas, AI data-center demand for new-type ultra-high-capacity, ultra-low-latency, ultra-low-loss fiber and cable kept growing, and supply-side optimisation during the downturn sped up the improvement in supply and demand.

2025 annual report: G.654.E fiber for backbone upgrades and long-distance data-center interconnect scaled up commercially. In June 2025 China Mobile's G.654.E cable centralized procurement totalled 314 ten-thousand core-km (about 156% more than its previous round); in October China Telecom's trunk-cable procurement included about 224 ten-thousand core-km of G.654.E cable, its first framework procurement of the product. YOFC won the largest share in both. Its mid-to-high-end single-mode and multimode fiber for intra-data-center links also grew well.
quarterly_data.figure: 314 ten-thousand core-km (+156%); about 224 ten-thousand core-km; largest share in both

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: YOFC's hollow-core fiber has 31% lower latency and 47% higher transmission speed than conventional solid-core fiber with near-zero nonlinear effects; more than ten commercial and pilot hollow-core projects are deployed in Asia, Europe and the Americas, and in 2025 it helped three domestic operator customers complete their respective first hollow-core commercial lines (company: 2025 was the first year of hollow-core commercial use). In February 2026 it launched the hollow-core fiber brand HollowBand and plans, with global telecom operators and cloud service providers, to drive more than 50 hollow-core commercial and pilot projects. It also offers multi-core fiber, high-quality multimode fiber and 800G/1.6T high-speed optical modules for intelligent-computing centers.
quarterly_data.figure: 31% lower latency; 47% higher speed; more than 50 planned projects

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: in optical interconnect components, subsidiary Broadex Technologies (Changxin Bochuang) expanded capacity in Indonesia on schedule and completed a '1+3' global production system (Indonesia plus Jiaxing, Chengdu and Hanchuan); its PON optical modules were upgraded and its 400G/800G AEC products and multimode 400G SR4 and 800G SR8 products are able to supply in volume; its 2025 R&D spending was RMB 1.27 hundred million, above 5% of its revenue.

2025 annual report: YOFC completed the acquisition of 51% of Changfei Fiber Materials (Hubei) Co. (formerly named Changfei Shin-Etsu (Hubei) Preform Co.) at the end of January 2025, consolidating it (impact on 2025 profit RMB 90,511,067), and the acquisition of Bente Laser (Zhejiang) in July 2025, building an industrial-laser chain from special fiber to lasers and laser equipment. It completed its optical quartz components R&D and industrialisation project with key customer breakthroughs; associate Changfei Advanced Semiconductor produced the first wafer at its Wuhan base in May 2025.

2025 annual report: construction in progress was RMB 1,557,227,040 at year-end (start of year RMB 2,082,556,415); the largest items were the Changfei Peru broadband installation project RMB 677,715,483 and the Changfei quartz construction project RMB 641,391,983; the Indonesia fiber phase-three plant and equipment project stood at RMB 11,770,564 (start of year RMB 114,937,760).

2025 annual report: R&D spending RMB 894,327,738, up 13.61% (6.28% of revenue, none capitalised); 1,428 R&D staff (13.48% of employees); in 2025 it filed 283 patent applications and was granted 319 patents.

2025 annual report: top five customers bought RMB 315,423.31 ten-thousand, 22.13% of 2025 sales; related-party sales among them RMB 52,565.32 ten-thousand (3.69% of sales); names and individual shares not disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 22.13% of 2025 sales (related party 3.69%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: top five suppliers supplied RMB 141,321.60 ten-thousand, 15.60% of 2025 purchases; related-party purchases among them RMB 80,604.67 ten-thousand (8.90% of purchases); names not disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: top five suppliers 15.60% of 2025 purchases (related party 8.90%)

quarterly_data.signal: Company (2026 business plan in the 2025 annual report): under an 'AI-driven, multi-synergy, global layout' strategy YOFC will speed its shift from single-product provider to comprehensive cable and solutions provider; it will keep improving ordinary single-mode efficiency while accelerating scale commercial use of new-type fiber, push more than 50 hollow-core commercial and pilot projects with operators and cloud providers, and expand overseas customers and delivery capacity - especially new-type fiber for intelligent-computing centers - to raise the overseas share of revenue further.
